description: Image Description: The image contains a single, handwritten digit "4" in black ink on a white background. The digit is written in a cursive style, with a smooth, continuous stroke that forms the characteristic shape of the number four. The top of the digit features a short horizontal line extending to the right, followed by a vertical line descending from the left end of the horizontal line. A diagonal stroke connects the bottom of the vertical line to the right, forming the base of the "4".
